justification: Contribution is periodic summarization of tool-use history to keep a compact working context past the window limit (SUPO's policy gradient serves it); evidence is lab benchmark runs on function calling and search.

ARC's claim is online maintenance of a revisable working context (incremental construction plus triggered reorganization) against context rot; evidence is five long-horizon information-seeking benchmarks in the lab.

The artefact is PRInTS, a generative process reward model producing the step-quality judgement used to accept candidate steps; measured on FRAMES, GAIA and WebWalkerQA in the lab. Runner-up: deliberative_search.

GT-MCP's mechanism is a trust function that accepts or rejects outputs against a validated context graph and rolls back on instability; evidence is 500 lab turns under an adaptive adversarial threat model.

SAM contributes a consolidate-and-recall policy (compact cues over preserved trajectory pages) governing what past interaction is reachable; validated on BrowseComp, BrowseComp-ZH, WideSearch and HLE in the lab.

The artefact is a diagnostic characterisation of why coding agents fail (trajectory structure discriminates, length is a confound, LLM dominates framework) from 9,374 trajectories over 500 benchmarked tasks.
PCF proposes tier-aligned write-time context isolation and a Context Lifecycle Model with retention contracts; the paper states it is conceptual and leaves empirical validation to future work.

ReTree is a bounded tree-structured memory abstraction keeping per-step context small with source-linked evidence; validated on four public QA and search benchmarks. Runner-up: planning_and_control_flow for its backtracking.
DPEPO's contribution is diverse parallel exploration across several environments per step, with rewards penalising redundant actions and states; lab benchmark results on ALFWorld and ScienceWorld.

STRACE feeds a reflection-based optimizer that rewrites agent policies between runs, contributing failure-pattern mining and causal root-cause localisation over traces; evidence is lab benchmark gains on VeruSAGE-Bench.

A meta agent rewrites the harness (instructions, tools, orchestration loops) from failure trajectories between runs; evidence is lab runs over seven business tasks and three SLM families. Runner-up: budget_and_termination_control.

Headline artefact is MedBench v5, a benchmark instrument with information-flow stressors, a process-audit protocol and hallucination-propagation monitoring; frontier models are scored on it in the lab.

Contributes a diagnostic account of agent reasoning (evidence ignored in 68% of traces, scaffold explains 1.5% of variance) from 25,000 runs with base model and scaffold deliberately varied across eight domains.

The mechanism is selection over candidate rollouts: Recursive Tournament Voting narrows a population by small-group comparison, with distilled summaries for sequential reuse; lab results on SWE-Bench Verified and Terminal-Bench.

ReSum's claim is periodic condensation of interaction history into compact summaries so exploration is unbounded, with GRPO adapted to the segmented trajectories; evidence is lab benchmark gains over ReAct.

The artefact is a measuring instrument, the AgentMeter Score scoring quality, budget sensitivity and zero-reward execution, plus a description-variant procedure for fairness; LM-CLI pairs are scored in the lab.

Contribution is automated search over harness configurations that improves the agent between runs, formalised as constrained Bayesian optimization; evidence is one four-round tuning study on a production coding agent.

AdaMEM contributes retrieval that continues through the episode, pairing offline trajectory memory with short-term strategy memory generated on the fly; validated on ALFWorld, WebShop and HotpotQA in the lab.

The artefact is a 12-dimension source-code taxonomy of coding-agent scaffolds and five composable loop primitives, an instrument spanning mechanisms rather than proposing one; grounded in 13 open-source agents at pinned commits.

ActiveMem decouples memory from reasoning, with a parallel distributed store accumulating and consolidating gists the Planner reads; validated on BrowseComp-Plus and GAIA. Runner-up: multi_agent_coordination.

ReasoningBank is a write-retrieve-consolidate policy distilling strategies from self-judged successes and failures across sessions; lab benchmark results on web browsing and software engineering. Runner-up: self_evolution.
PEEK caches reusable orientation knowledge as a fixed-budget context map maintained by distil, edit and evict modules; measured on long-context reasoning and aggregation benchmarks against ACE.

DREvo is a harness self-evolution method that recalibrates historical trial evidence into search directions across evolution iterations; evidence is lab accuracy on five domain-reasoning and agentic benchmarks.

RSCB-MC is a retrieval-control policy choosing among no-memory, injection, summarisation, abstention and asking for feedback under a false-positive penalty; evidence is offline replay and a bounded 200-case validation against baselines.

An empirical audit of one named context-management mechanism, masking stale observations, yielding a regime map over retriever strength and model capacity; conditions swept over backbones from 4B to 284B and three retrievers.
